title: Pashupatinath Temple Tour
notes: Visit the main temple complex, explore the banks of Bagmati River, observe cremation ceremonies at the ghats, and see the many linga shrines. Best visited early morning or late afternoon.

title: Lunch & Rest
notes: Enjoy traditional Newari or Nepali cuisine at a nearby restaurant.

title: Boudhanath Stupa Visit
notes: Walk clockwise around the largest stupa in Nepal, spin prayer wheels, visit surrounding monasteries and shops. Evenings offer a serene atmosphere with butter lamp offerings.

title: Swayambhunath Stupa Visit
notes: Climb the 365 steps to the Monkey Temple. Explore the main stupa with Buddha's eyes, visit the temple complex with shrines and statues, and enjoy panoramic views of Kathmandu Valley.

title: Budhanilkantha Visit
notes: Optional visit to the reclining Vishnu statue at Budhanilkantha, a short drive away.

title: Bhaktapur Durbar Square Tour
notes: Explore the 55 Window Palace, Nyatapola Temple (Nepal's tallest pagoda), Vatsala Temple, Golden Gate, and Pottery Square. Taste famous Bhaktapur curd (juju dhau) and local yogurt.

title: Changu Narayan Visit
notes: Short drive to Nepal's oldest temple, a UNESCO site dedicated to Lord Vishnu, dating back to the 4th century.

title: Patan Durbar Square Tour
notes: Explore the ancient Royal Palace, Krishna Mandir (stone temple), Hiranya Varna Mahavihar (Golden Temple), and the Patan Museum. Admire the finest collection of Newari architecture in Nepal.

title: Lumbini Sacred Garden Tour
notes: Visit the sacred Maya Devi Temple marking Buddha's birthplace, the Ashoka Pillar with its ancient inscription, and the sacred pond. Walk through the beautifully landscaped gardens.

title: Monastery Zone Visit
notes: Explore the eastern and western monastery zones featuring Buddhist temples built by countries around the world including Thailand, Myanmar, China, Japan, Germany, and Sri Lanka.

title: Janaki Mandir Tour
notes: Visit the magnificent white palace-like temple dedicated to Goddess Sita. Explore the three-story structure with its 60 rooms, colorful glasswork, and intricate carvings. Learn about the Ramayana connection.

title: Janakpur City Exploration
notes: Explore the city's ponds (dighis), the Ram Mandir, and the local bazaar known for Mithila paintings and handicrafts.

title: Chitwan Safari Day 1
notes: Arrive in Sauraha. Afternoon canoe ride along the Rapti River for bird watching and crocodile spotting. Evening Tharu cultural dance performance.

title: Chitwan Safari Day 2
notes: Early morning jungle safari (jeep or elephant-back) to spot one-horned rhinoceros, deer, wild boar, and if lucky, the Bengal tiger. Afternoon nature walk with a trained guide.

title: Pokhara City Tour
notes: Morning boat ride on Phewa Lake to visit the Tal Barahi Temple on the island. Enjoy the reflection of Machhapuchhre peak on the lake's surface.

title: Pokhara Sightseeing
notes: Visit Devi's Fall, Gupteshwor Cave, the International Mountain Museum, and World Peace Pagoda. Evening at Lakeside restaurants with mountain views.

title: Sarangkot Sunrise
notes: Early morning drive or hike to Sarangkot for stunning sunrise views over the Annapurna and Dhaulagiri ranges. Paragliding option available.

title: Nagarkot Sunrise & Hike
notes: Pre-dawn hike to the viewpoint for spectacular sunrise over the Himalayas. On clear days, views span from Annapurna to Everest. Morning hike through pine forests and local villages.

title: Bandipur Exploration
notes: Walk the historic main street lined with traditional Newari houses and inns. Visit the Bindabasini Temple, Tundikhel viewpoint, and Siddha Gufa (largest cave in Nepal). Enjoy panoramic mountain views.

title: Manakamana Temple Visit
notes: Scenic cable car ride over the Trishuli River valley. Visit the sacred temple of Goddess Bhagwati, seek blessings for wish fulfillment. Enjoy views of the surrounding hills and river valley.

title: Chandragiri Hills Trip
notes: Take Nepal's longest cable car to the top of Chandragiri Hills at 2,551m. Visit the Shiva temple, enjoy panoramic Himalayan views, have lunch at the hilltop restaurant. Perfect for a half-day Kathmandu getaway.

title: Trek to Gosaikunda
notes: Drive from Kathmandu to Dhunche or Betrawati (5-6 hours). Brief trek to the first overnight stop.

title: Gosaikunda Lake Trek
notes: Continue the trek through beautiful rhododendron and pine forests to reach the sacred Gosaikunda Lake at 4,380m. Visit the lakeside shrines and enjoy the dramatic mountain scenery.

title: Drive to Nayapul, Trek to Tikhedhunga
notes: Drive from Pokhara to Nayapul (1.5 hrs), then begin trekking along the Modi Khola river. Gradual ascent through terraced fields and small settlements to reach Tikhedhunga.

title: Tikhedhunga to Ghorepani
notes: Steep climb up the famous stone staircase at Ulleri (3380 steps). The trail passes through beautiful rhododendron and oak forests. Reward is panoramic mountain views from Ghorepani.

title: Poon Hill Sunrise to Tadapani
notes: Pre-dawn hike to Poon Hill (3,210m) for spectacular sunrise over Annapurna and Dhaulagiri ranges. After breakfast, trek through scenic ridge-top trails to Tadapani.

title: Tadapani to Chhomrong
notes: A shorter day through beautiful forests with occasional mountain views. Chhomrong is a beautiful Gurung village with stone-paved streets and stunning views of Annapurna South.

title: Chhomrong to Himalaya Hotel
notes: Descend to Chhomrong Khola, then ascend through bamboo forests. Pass through Sinuwa, Bamboo, and Dovan. The valley narrows and the landscape becomes increasingly alpine.

title: Himalaya Hotel to Annapurna Base Camp
notes: Trek through Deurali to Machhapuchhre Base Camp with its stunning views, then continue to ABC at 4,130m. Surrounded by a natural amphitheater of Himalayan peaks.

title: ABC Sunrise, Trek to Chhomrong
notes: Witness sunrise over Annapurna massif from ABC. Begin the return trek descending through Bamboo and Sinuwa back to Chhomrong.

title: Chhomrong to Nayapul, Drive to Pokhara
notes: Trek down to Jhinu Danda for a relaxing dip in natural hot springs, then continue through Landruk to Nayapul. Drive back to Pokhara.

title: Nayapul to Tikhedhunga
notes: Drive from Pokhara to Nayapul. Trek through terraced fields and small settlements along the Modi Khola river to reach Tikhedhunga.

title: Tikhedhunga to Ghorepani
notes: A challenging day climbing the stone staircase at Ulleri. Continue through rhododendron forests to the hilltop settlement of Ghorepani with its stunning mountain panorama.

title: Poon Hill Sunrise to Tadapani
notes: Early morning hike to Poon Hill for Nepal's best sunrise views over 8 Himalayan peaks above 8,000m. Return to Ghorepani for breakfast, then trek to Tadapani through rhododendron forests.

title: Tadapani to Landruk
notes: A scenic descent through forests and traditional Gurung villages to Landruk on the Modi Khola riverbank. Experience village life and local hospitality.

title: Landruk to Nayapul, Drive to Pokhara
notes: Final trekking leg along the riverbank back to Nayapul. Drive to Pokhara for a well-deserved rest and celebration dinner.

title: Fly to Lukla, Trek to Phakding
notes: Early morning scenic flight to Lukla (2,860m). Trek through pine forests and across suspension bridges along the Dudh Koshi River to reach Phakding.

title: Phakding to Namche Bazaar
notes: Cross several high suspension bridges including the famous Hillary Bridge. A steep final climb rewards you with the first views of Everest. Explore the bustling Sherpa capital of Namche.

title: Namche Acclimatization Day
notes: Hike to Everest View Hotel (3,880m) for stunning views of Everest, Lhotse, and Ama Dablam. Visit the Sherpa Museum and local monasteries. Climb high, sleep low.

title: Namche to Tyangboche
notes: Trek along the ridge with incredible mountain views. Visit the famous Tengboche Monastery, the largest in Khumbu, and enjoy sunset views of Ama Dablam and Everest.

title: Tyangboche to Dingboche
notes: Descend through rhododendron forests to the Imja Khola valley. Climb to Dingboche with its stunning mountain backdrop. Views of Lhotse, Island Peak, and Ama Dablam.

title: Dingboche Acclimatization Day
notes: Hike to Nagarjun Hill (5,100m) for panoramic views. Rest and hydrate. Preparation for higher altitude in the coming days.

title: Dingboche to Lobuche
notes: Trek across alpine terrain with views of glaciers and moraines. Visit the memorial chortens for fallen climbers. The landscape becomes stark and otherworldly at 4,930m.

title: Lobuche to Everest Base Camp
notes: Trek across the Khumbu Glacier moraine to Gorakshep. Drop bags and continue to Everest Base Camp (5,364m). Stand at the foot of the world's highest mountain.

title: Kala Patthar Sunrise, Trek to Lobuche
notes: Pre-dawn hike to Kala Patthar (5,555m) for the best sunrise views of Everest. Return to Gorakshep for breakfast, then descend to Lobuche.

title: Lobuche to Tyangboche
notes: Descend through Dingboche and back to Tyangboche. The lower altitude allows for easier walking and better sleep.

title: Tyangboche to Namche Bazaar
notes: Continue the descent through beautiful forests back to Namche. Enjoy the comforts of bakeries and shops in the Sherpa capital.

title: Namche to Phakding
notes: Easy descent through pine forests and across suspension bridges. Relax in Phakding with its river views.

title: Phakding to Lukla
notes: Final trekking day back to Lukla. Celebrate the achievement with fellow trekkers. Last chance for souvenir shopping.

title: Fly to Kathmandu
notes: Early morning flight back to Kathmandu. Rest, recover, and celebrate the completion of an epic Himalayan adventure.

title: Drive to Syabrubesi
notes: Scenic drive from Kathmandu through the Trishuli River valley to Syabrubesi (1,503m). Settle into teahouse and prepare for tomorrow's trek.

title: Syabrubesi to Lama Hotel
notes: Trek along the Langtang River through lush bamboo and rhododendron forests. Keep an eye out for langur monkeys and various bird species. Gradual ascent through the day.

title: Lama Hotel to Langtang Village
notes: Continue through forests that gradually thin out as altitude increases. The valley opens up revealing stunning views of Langtang Lirung. Visit the rebuilt Langtang Village.

title: Langtang Village to Kyanjin Gompa
notes: A shorter trekking day through dramatic alpine scenery. Visit the famous Kyanjin Gompa monastery and the local cheese factory. Panoramic views of Langtang Lirung and surrounding peaks.

title: Kyanjin Ri Hike & Exploration
notes: Early morning hike to Kyanjin Ri (4,773m) for breathtaking sunrise views of the Langtang range and into Tibet. Afternoon exploring the glaciers and moraines around Kyanjin Gompa.

title: Kyanjin Gompa to Langtang Village
notes: Easy descent back through beautiful alpine meadows to Langtang Village. Relax and enjoy the mountain views. Interact with local Tamang families.

title: Langtang Village to Syabrubesi
notes: Full day of descent through the Langtang Valley. The forest becomes denser as you lose altitude. Final night in the mountains at Syabrubesi.

title: Drive to Kathmandu
notes: Scenic drive back to Kathmandu with views of the Trishuli River valley. Arrive by afternoon with memories of a beautiful Himalayan valley.

title: Phedi to Forest Camp
notes: Steady climb through pristine rhododendron and oak forest above Phedi.

title: Forest Camp to High Camp
notes: Alpine meadows open to huge views of Mardi Himal and Machhapuchhre.

title: High Camp to Mardi Himal Base Camp
notes: Ridge walk to the 4,500m viewpoint and back; avoid after storms.

title: High Camp to Phedi
notes: Long descent through forest to the roadhead, then drive to Pokhara.

title: Aarughat to Jagat
notes: Follow the Budhi Gandaki through deep gorges and subtropical forest.

title: Jagat to Deng
notes: Climbing through terraced fields and Tamang villages.

title: Deng to Namrung
notes: Tall forest and gorges; first views of Manaslu begin to appear.

title: Namrung to Samagaon
notes: Tibetan-style villages; afternoon acclimatization walk.

title: Samagaon rest day
notes: Visit Manaslu Base Camp and the Pungen Gompa.

title: Samagaon to Larkya Dharamsala
notes: Climb the moraine to the high camp below Larkya La.

title: Lukla to Namche Bazaar
notes: Suspension bridges, Dudh Koshi valley and the steep climb into Namche.

title: Namche acclimatization
notes: Hike to Everest View Hotel or Khumjung for acclimatization.

title: Namche to Dole
notes: Quieter trail up the Bhote Koshi valley with big mountain views.

title: Dole to Machermo
notes: Short climb to the Gokyo gateway village; rest before the lakes.

title: Machermo to Gokyo
notes: Pass the first turquoise lakes to Gokyo village at 4,790m.

title: Besisahar to Bahundanda
notes: Marsyangdi river, waterfalls and rice terraces; hot springs option at Tal.

title: Bahundanda to Chame
notes: Valley narrows into dramatic gorges; Chame has natural hot springs.

title: Chame to Pisang
notes: Views of Annapurna II and lamjung; catch sunset colours on the peaks.

title: Pisang to Manang
notes: Desert-like upper valley opens with stunning Himalayan views.

title: Manang acclimatization
notes: Climb to Gangapurna glacier lake for acclimatization.

title: Manang to Thorong Phedi
notes: Short valley to the windy camping settlement below the pass.

title: Thorong La and Muktinath
notes: Start before dawn, cross Thorong La (5,416m), descend to the temple.

title: Muktinath to Jomsom
notes: Windy descent through the Kali Gandaki; fly or drive to Pokhara.

title: Shivapuri Day Hike from Budhanilkantha
notes: Drive to Budhanilkantha at the northern edge of Kathmandu, trek through the Shivapuri Nagarjun National Park forest to Nagi Gompa and continue to the 2,563 m summit. Spectacular Kathmandu Valley views from the ridge. Return via the same trail or descend to Sundarijal.
